source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Ακύλας και Ιλάριος»

attestations.note: The life page /704/ heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the pair one sentence: they were martyred by stoning, «Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τους βίους τους». He is not the corpus's `aquila`, the apostle and husband of Priscilla, who is on the same day page under a separate entry and a separate life page (/708/) and whose Greek row is already venerated on 13 Φεβρουαρίου: two entries on one day page are two commemorations, so two men. Nor is he `aquila-the-eparch` (20 Μαρτίου) or `aquila-of-trebizond` (21 Ιανουαρίου). The name is given with no byname at all, so the day disambiguates the folder, as it does for the corpus's other bare names. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. No year, no place, no emperor and no judge is printed, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and the page prints no hymn.
